name: 360Quadrants

sources.title: 360Quadrants — MarketsandMarkets analyst quadrant platform; 'analyst-verified insights' across 7,000+ micro-markets, 96,000+ companies; 'Purchase Request'/'Request Sample Report' CTAs; contact info@360quadrants.com / +1 888 600 6441

conditions: No submission route — company placement in quadrants is analyst-driven (MarketsandMarkets methodology); vendors can't self-list
requirements: B2B/emerging-tech market presence — quadrants map vendors in micro-markets (AI, cybersecurity, GPUaaS, knowledge graphs, etc.)
Analyst evaluation — positions come from MarketsandMarkets' evaluation journey, not submissions
The commercial model is report sales + vendor engagement — a 'Companies' directory exists but profiles are analyst-curated
Contact route: info@360quadrants.com or the LiveChat widget
preparation: Analyst-relations approach — materials a MnM analyst could use (product docs, customer evidence, market positioning)
workflow: Contact 360Quadrants/MarketsandMarkets via info@360quadrants.com or the on-site LiveChat
Ask about inclusion criteria for the relevant micro-market quadrant
Commercial briefing/relationship likely required for evaluation
watchFor: Analyst-firm model — quadrant placement typically follows briefings/engagement, not a form
Vendor-profile claims may exist via the signup system, but curation is theirs
This is B2B procurement research — consumer/startup-launch fit is weak
countsAsLive: The company appears as a vendor in a 360Quadrants micro-market quadrant
unknowns: Whether vendors can claim/update their own profiles
